details.summary: 在Netflix节目录制中预言Ricki Lake会因火灾或水患遭财产损失(2024-10录制,2025-01洛杉矶山火后马里布住宅被毁获证实)
details.detail: 据 Decider 2025年1月13日报道，Ricki Lake 在 Instagram 上写道：“The great @tylerhenrymedium called it! Less than three months ago, on Oct 15th, 2024 Ross and I were on Tyler's show and guys, he SAW the fire”，节目为 Netflix 每周直播脱口秀《Live From The Other Side With Tyler Henry》，每周二 6/5c 播出，她与丈夫一同录制。片段中 Henry 说：“I'm trying to articulate this without it sounding concerning — I think this may have already happened, if there was a loss of material objects from a fire and water”，并称看到“a house fire, or something along those lines, a fire risk”，还预言会有“water seepage into a place it shouldn't”损坏她的物品。数日前 Lake 发文称马里布住宅“It's all gone”，那是三年前她结婚的地方。此次洛杉矶山火据估计波及全县多达 10,000 处建筑，以 Pacific Palisades 和 Eaton 灾情最重。
